    AI Overview
    The 2026 men's golf majors schedule features iconic venues: The Masters (April 9–12, Augusta National), PGA Championship (May 14–17, Aronimink GC), U.S. Open (June 18–21, Shinnecock Hills), and The Open Championship (July 16–19, Royal Birkdale). Rory McIlroy won the 2026 Masters. 
    2026 Men's Major Championship Schedule 
    • Masters Tournament (April 9-12): Augusta National Golf Club, Augusta, Georgia. Winner: Rory McIlroy.
    • PGA Championship (May 14-17): Aronimink Golf Club, Newtown Square, Pennsylvania.
    • U.S. Open (June 18-21): Shinnecock Hills Golf Club, Southampton, New York.
    • The Open Championship
      (July 16-19):
      154th Open at Royal Birkdale Golf Club, Southport, England.
       
    2026 Women's Major Championship Schedule 
    • Chevron Championship (April 23-26): Club at Carlton Woods, The Woodlands, Texas.
    • U.S. Women's Open (June 4-7): Riviera Country Club, Pacific Palisades, California.
    • KPMG Women's PGA Championship (June 25-28): Hazeltine National Golf Club, Chaska, Minnesota.
    • The Amundi Evian Championship (July 9-12): Evian Resort Golf Club, Evian-les-Bains, France. 
    Other Key 2026 Events 
    • The Players Championship: March 12–15, TPC Sawgrass.
    • Presidents Cup: Sept 22–27, Medinah Country Club.
